description: A relational sorted theory has a model with every sort nonempty if and only if each finite subset has such a model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.compactness.{u, v}
  (L : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Signature)
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Theory L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.IsSatisfiable L T ↔
    ∀ (T₀ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Sentence L)),
      ↑T₀ ⊆ T → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.IsSatisfiable L ↑T₀
